routes.label: Write every factor as a power of 3

question: The logarithm of \(27\sqrt[4]{9}\sqrt[3]{9}\) to the base \(3\) is:
solution:
The base-3 logarithm asks which exponent of \(3\) produces the given number. Write each positive factor as a power of \(3\):
\[
27=3^3,\qquad
\sqrt[4]{9}=3^{2/4}=3^{1/2},\qquad
\sqrt[3]{9}=3^{2/3}.
\]
Multiplying powers with the same positive base adds their exponents, so
\[
27\sqrt[4]{9}\sqrt[3]{9}
=3^{3+1/2+2/3}
=3^{25/6}.
\]
Therefore its base-3 logarithm is \(\boxed{\frac{25}{6}=4\frac16}\), choice B.
